events.subtitle: 60th Anniversary Concert of John Coltrane's Offering: Live at Temple University
events.category: John Coltrane centennial / Album anniversary / Philadelphia jazz history
events.factual_description: Coltrane 100 Philly culminates on November 12, 2026 with a 60th-anniversary concert centered on John Coltrane's Offering: Live at Temple University. Visit Philadelphia identifies Temple Performing Arts Center as the venue and describes the program as a reimagining of the landmark approximately 90-minute performance. Jazz Philadelphia, one of the coordinating organizations behind Coltrane 100 Philly, confirms that the citywide centennial season culminates in November with a tribute to the 60th anniversary of Offering. Temple University documents that the original concert was recorded at Mitten Hall on November 11, 1966, nine months before Coltrane's death. No performing lineup or showtime is stated in the authoritative current-event sources checked, so none is inferred here.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because the context is inseparable from the music. Philadelphia is closing its John Coltrane centennial with a 60th-anniversary return to Offering, one of the fiercest late-period Coltrane documents, at Temple University, the institution where the 1966 performance was captured. The attraction is not a generic tribute repertoire but the attempt to re-enter an unusually open, ecstatic and experimental piece of Philadelphia jazz history during the exact centennial year. The still-unannounced personnel keep it at S for now rather than S+.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated regional trip to Philadelphia from the DC corridor if the announced realization matches the historical ambition of the project. The one-off centennial/60th-anniversary context and Temple connection make the date itself meaningful; reassess for S+ once the performing lineup is published.

es.why_it_matters: Cruza a S porque el contexto es inseparable de la música. Filadelfia cerrará su centenario de John Coltrane con una vuelta por los 60 años de Offering, uno de los documentos más feroces del Coltrane tardío, dentro de Temple University, la institución donde quedó registrada la actuación de 1966. El atractivo no es un repertorio genérico de homenaje, sino intentar volver a entrar a una pieza extraordinariamente abierta, extática y experimental de la historia jazzística de Filadelfia durante el año exacto del centenario. Como todavía no se anuncia el elenco, por ahora se queda en S y no S+.
es.trip_verdict: S. Sí vale un viaje regional dedicado a Filadelfia desde el corredor de DC si la realización anunciada está a la altura de la ambición histórica del proyecto. El contexto irrepetible de centenario + 60 aniversario y la conexión con Temple hacen significativa la fecha misma; conviene reevaluarla para S+ cuando publiquen el elenco.
